d:
Delhi Police has granted permission for the INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan on November 1, 2026. The permission comes with strict conditions, including ending the rally by 5 PM and no overnight stay. The police has also imposed rules on CCTV surveillance, volunteers, parking, speeches and crowd management. Meanwhile, Delhi traders have urged Congress to postpone the rally until after November 10 due to the festive season.
Rahul Gandhi has said that the protest can end in 30 seconds if CEC Gyanesh Kumar is removed.
